label: Cultural Wardrobe
description: Traditional garments with authentic construction details, phrased respectfully.

items.name: kimono-furisode
items.text: an elegant silk furisode kimono, long swinging sleeves, hand-tied brocade obi finished in an otaiko knot

items.name: yukata-summer
items.text: a light indigo-dyed cotton yukata, crisp pressed folds, simple contrast obi tied at the back

items.name: hanbok
items.text: a flowing hanbok, short jeogori jacket with a long otgoreum ribbon over a full high-waisted chima skirt in bright silk

items.name: sari-silk
items.text: a richly embroidered silk sari, gold zari border, pallu draped over the shoulder in even pleats

items.name: qipao
items.text: a fitted silk-brocade qipao, mandarin collar, knotted frog closures and a high side slit

items.name: dirndl
items.text: a traditional dirndl, laced velvet bodice over a full skirt and apron, white puff-sleeve blouse

items.name: kaftan
items.text: an embroidered flowing kaftan in saturated jewel tones, wide sleeves, metallic thread tracing the neckline

items.name: vyshyvanka
items.text: a vyshyvanka dress of white linen, dense red-and-black cross-stitch bands at the sleeves and collar

items.name: kilt-formal
items.text: a formal tartan kilt with a horsehair sporran, Prince Charlie jacket and polished ghillie brogues

items.name: agbada
items.text: a flowing embroidered agbada in rich damask, wide draped sleeves over matching trousers and cap

items.name: flamenco
items.text: a traje de flamenca fitted through the hips into cascading ruffled tiers, polka-dot fabric and a long fringed shawl

items.name: ao-dai
items.text: a silk áo dài, high-collared fitted tunic split to the waist over flowing white trousers, the panels streaming behind each step

items.name: lederhosen
items.text: traditional lederhosen of embossed deer leather, drop-front flap, embroidered H-bar braces over a checked shirt, wool socks and haferl shoes
